expectations.evidence: (blocking) Security: Stored XSS. Comment markdown is rendered as HTML without sanitizing ... File: src/components/CommentList.tsx:19
(blocking) `[x](javascript:alert(1))` -> `<a href="javascript:alert(1" ...>` (`javascript:` URL scheme passes through) ... allow only `http:`, `https:` and `mailto:` link targets
(blocking) `useEffect` lost its `postId` dependency and its cancellation guard ... it never refetches ... a slow response can arrive after unmount or after a newer request and overwrite state
(should_fix) List items are keyed by index instead of `c.id` ... React will reuse the wrong DOM nodes
(should_fix) Performance: O(n²) participant de-dupe on threads with thousands of comments ... Count unique authors with a Set ... memoize
(should_fix) `moment` added even though `date-fns` and a helper already exist ... use `relativeTime(last.createdAt)`
(should_fix) One happy-path test for a security-sensitive renderer ... Nothing covers italic, code, links, newlines ... or HTML/XSS input
